changes: Model replacement requires captured epoch/document/revision/state token; stale replies leave all state unchanged.
Derived capabilities align critical menus, controls and handlers; no additional mutable state or production modules.
Zero-offset resize of dictionary storage shares immutable base containers; shifted/BlockArray resize retains full path.
Operation switching preserves Mix and per-operation Conditions; preview and applied states match.

checks.navigation: deferred: locked macOS session; user authorized delivery without focus test

package.installation: passed: bundled demo, NBT batch, Apply, Save/reopen, Undo, world overview

regressions: Same-revision sibling replies in both orders, duplicate reply, reopen/close, changed state ID, preserved selection.
Protected Apply blocks Discard/Save; placement waits for model and displayed scene; repeat/stroke block ordinary edits.
Connected mode stays active while its worker runs; material picker can invalidate a ready preview without editing history.
NoScan storage catches resize traversal; snapshot/fork independence, NBT/entities, Save/reopen and mixed-direction Undo/Redo.

zero_offset_resize.method: Median of 5; Python 3.9.6, arm64. Dictionary base (1000,1,N/1000), one-block paste at (1000,0,0). Branch fork and gc before timing; in-memory branch history.
zero_offset_resize.excluded: GUI, IPC, fork cost, persistent history, BlockArray and negative-offset resize; this is not an end-to-end latency guarantee.

native_workflow.rss_sampling: ps RSS sum every 20 ms plus subprocess time; shared pages may be counted twice
native_workflow.assertions: Take, Save and reload, Undo, Redo, block NBT, entities, bounds and untouched source

verification_notes: Connected smoke previously sent two rapid Escape presses and waited in ExitDialog (Python stack confirmed). Separate cancellations now wait beyond the existing double-Escape interval; product navigation is unchanged.
Source and package logs are in the isolated temporary run directory; required commands and scenarios remain in tools/check_edit.py.
Large negative-offset Take remains a performance issue; the 408.56 ms GUI gap was not improved by this fast path.
